episodeTitle.en: How a great founder becomes a great CEO | Jonathan Lowenhar (co-founder of Enjoy The Work)
episodeTitle.zh: 伟大创始人如何成为卓越CEO | 乔纳森·洛文哈尔（Enjoy The Work联合创始人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jonathan Lowenhar is the co-founder of Enjoy The Work, an executive coaching firm that helps founders become great CEOs. Over the past decade, Enjoy The Work has supported over 165 founders on their journey to becoming better leaders. In our conversation, we discuss: • The difference between being a founder and being a CEO
guestBioOfficial.zh: 乔纳森·洛文哈尔（Jonathan Lowenhar）是Enjoy The Work的联合创始人，这是一家帮助创始人成长为卓越CEO的执行力教练公司。在过去十年间，Enjoy The Work已为超过165位创始人提供了支持，助力他们成为更出色的领导者。在我们的对谈中，我们探讨了：• 创始人与CEO身份的差异

title.en: How a great founder becomes a great CEO | Jonathan Lowenhar (co-founder of Enjoy The Work)
title.zh: 伟大创始人如何成为卓越CEO | 乔纳森·洛文哈尔（Enjoy The Work联合创始人）

summary.en: Jonathan draws a sharp line between being a founder (a state of being) and being a CEO (a craft), and pushes back on 'founder mode' as an excuse for not learning the job—the best CEOs know when to calibrate between the two. He walks through the two phases of a startup (build something people want; then build a company around it), the most common CEO failure modes, and his 'Magic Box' paradigm for a successful exit (never be 'for sale'—seduce the buyer instead). The episode is full of advice on hiring, building a repeatable go-to-market motion, and trusting your intuition as a founder.
summary.zh: Jonathan 划清了“创始人”（一种存在状态）与“CEO”（一门手艺）的界限，并批评“创始人模式”成了不学本分的借口——最优秀的 CEO 知道何时在两者间切换。他拆解了创业的两个阶段（做出人们想买的东西；再围绕它建一家公司）、最常见的 CEO 失败模式，以及他用于成功退出的“Magic Box”范式（永远不要“待售”——而要 seduce 买方）。这期节目充满关于招聘、打造可复制的上市动作、以及作为创始人学会信任直觉的建议。
